facts.business: Sylph Industries Limited is engaged in the information technology (IT) and business process management (BPM) sector, and has also made strategic investments in the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector through Maxrotth Foods Limited.

capacity_or_capex.item: Subscription of equity shares in Maxrotth Foods Limited
Purchase of equity shares in Maxrotth Foods Limited from sellers
capacity_or_capex.timeline: As per Term Sheet dated 10th June, 2025

auditor.name: M/s. Bihari Shah & Co., Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Delay in submission of financial results under Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Geopolitical tensions and global trade restrictions
Commodity-price volatility and exchange rate fluctuations
Changes in government regulations and tax laws
facts.related_party_note: The Company executed a Term Sheet on 10th June, 2025 for subscription to 11,42,000 fresh equity shares and purchase of 8,35,000 equity shares of Maxrotth Foods Limited at INR 18 per share. Maxrotth Foods Limited allotted 11,42,000 equity shares to Sylph Technologies Limited on August 01, 2025.
